datasets.name: BioImage Archive (EMBL-EBI BioStudies)

checked.method: GET BioStudies search API ('fertilization oocyte sperm' and '"cortical tension"')

variables_present: fertilization imaging with sperm-entry kinetics (see S-BIAD2356 below)
variables_missing: any cortical-tension measurement of eggs around fertilization ('cortical tension' query returned 2 studies, both on somatic cells)
datasets.scope: Archive-wide: 68 hits for fertilization/oocyte/sperm, 2 for 'cortical tension' (S-BIAD1167 aster centration, S-BIAD2611 3T3 fibroblast cortex mechanics)
datasets.evidence: Search API totalHits 68 and 2; S-BIAD2611 record lists organism Mus musculus, 3T3 fibroblasts, licence CC BY 4.0, no eggs.

datasets.name: Role of the zona pellucida in gamete fusion and perivitelline space in blocking polyspermy in mice (S-BIAD2356)
variables_present: real-time bright-field and confocal imaging of inseminated mouse oocytes with kinetic tracking of sperm fusion and polyspermy prevention
datasets.evidence: Study record: title, description 'combines real-time imaging, confocal microscopy and statistical analysis to investigate fertilization and polyspermy prevention dynamics in mice', organism Mus musculus, licence CC BY 4.0, FTP link returned.

datasets.name: Segmentation of membrane of mouse, sea urchin and human oocytes from transmitted light images (Zenodo)
variables_present: transmitted-light images of mouse, human oocytes and sea urchin eggs with membrane segmentations (shape, not tension)
datasets.scope: Static oocyte images for a phenotyping ML paper
datasets.evidence: Zenodo record: title, licence cc-by-4.0, description 'images acquired in transmitted light ... of mouse and human oocytes and sea urchin eggs, with the correspon[ding segmentations]'.

search_log.note: S-BIAD2356 (mouse polyspermy block imaging) is the only fertilization-kinetics dataset; the rest are sperm cryo-ET and oogenesis.
Bird polyspermy counts, Lepidoptera micropyles, sea urchin gamete-recognition evolution; no tension or fertilization time series.
Loose match; only the oocyte membrane segmentation set (6502830) is a dataset, and it has no tension.
First page irrelevant (salmonid life history, transcriptomics, speculative preprints).

summary: No public repository dataset contains egg cortical or surface tension measured through fertilization. The closest archived material is fertilization imaging (S-BIAD2356, mouse, CC BY 4.0, sperm-fusion kinetics without mechanics) and static oocyte shape images; tension time series at fertilization (micropipette aspiration, AFM, or cortical-flow-based estimates in sea urchin, Xenopus, mouse) live only in paper figures.
next_step: Compile a table from the primary literature of pre- and post-fertilization cortical tension values with timing of the polyspermy block, membrane-potential change and cortical-granule exocytosis per species (sea urchin, Xenopus, mouse), or request raw traces from the authors; then pre-register whether a tension rise precedes or accompanies the block.
obstacles_confirmed: Direct tension measurements are rarely archived with fertilization movies (none found).
Tension time series at fertilization are in papers on a few model eggs.
